recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, satirical composition featuring two young women in patriotic attire flanking a central typographic block, framed by a text-heavy border and anchored by a low-angle shot of a government building.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical framing of the central subjects around a bold title
Contrast between the vibrant red/blue foreground and the soft sky background
Juxtaposition of youthful fashion with formal political architecture
Text-as-border framing the entire square composition
coreInvariants: Red, white, and blue color palette
Peripheral border containing a continuous string of text
Central silhouette integrated into the lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two medium-close-up figures occupy the left and right thirds, leaning inward toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title in the center-middle ground acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central red text, move up to the faces, then follow the border text clockwise around the perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper center area (sky) provides breathing room between the two subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright Red for primary branding and border text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blue for secondary text blocks and clothing patterns.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for highlights, stars, and the architectural base.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a desaturated, hazy blue sky.

letterConstructionRules: Integration of a human silhouette into a central character
characterSpecificRedesigns: Central letter replaced or overlaid with a full-body silhouette in a victory pose
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic hierarchy using weight and scale to distinguish the title from the metadata border.
graphicDevices: Solid blue rectangular banners behind secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the main title.
Provides the sturdy, classic American sans-serif look for the border.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A square photo of two young women with 90s hairstyles wearing star-spangled clothing, looking at the camera. They are positioned on the left and right, leaving the center open. In the bottom center, a small white neoclassical building is visible. The background is a bright, slightly hazy blue sky. A thin blue frame lines the inner edge of the square.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a massive red bold sans-serif title in the center. Replace the middle letter with a red silhouette of a man with arms raised. Add blue horizontal bars above and below the title with white sans-serif text. Create a white outer border and fill it with red bold sans-serif text running clockwise around all four sides.

verificationChecks: Is the central title red and extra-bold?
Is there a continuous text border around the entire image?
Are the two subjects wearing patriotic patterns?
Is the color palette strictly red, white, and blue?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the border text does not overlap the central image.
Ensure the red silhouette is clearly integrated into the central word.
Verify that the blue banners are perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the sky background is desaturated enough to not compete with the red text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Symmetrical Portraiture] + [Patriotic Color Palette] + [Heavy Sans-Serif Display Type] + [Text-Frame Border Layout] to create a satirical media cover.
